name: Mr. Whiskers Goes Home

start.dialog: Mr. Whiskers needs to visit his FAMILY! In the Mire! His COUSIN lives there! A python! Take us there? We need an ESCORT! The Mire is DANGEROUS for performers!
start.objective: Escort Sssilas and Mr. Whiskers to meet the python cousin in the Mire

progress.dialog: Mr. Whiskers is SO excited! Look at him wiggle! Almost there?
progress.objective: Continue through the Mire while protecting the duo

complete.dialog: REUNITED! Look at them! SNAKE FAMILY! Beautiful! Here - Mr. Whiskers' shed skin! Made into a belt! Lucky! Stylish! SLITHERY!

party_comments.kade: Snake family reunions. That's a first.

hidden_outcome: If Mr. Whiskers doesn't take any damage during the escort, the python gives you 'Serpent's Wisdom' - a permanent +2 to Wisdom
